title: The 5 Farthest Things We've Ever Sent Into Space, Ranked

scenes.text: Five human-made objects are farthest from home. Number one takes light nearly a day to reach.
Number five: New Horizons. More than sixty times Earth's distance from the Sun, after its flyby of Pluto.
scenes.label: New Horizons · 60+ AU

scenes.text: Number four: Pioneer 11. About one hundred seventeen times that distance. Contact was lost in 1995.
scenes.label: Pioneer 11 · 117 AU

scenes.text: Number three: Pioneer 10. Around one hundred forty times that distance, and silent since 2003.
scenes.label: Pioneer 10 · 140 AU

scenes.text: Number two: Voyager 2. About one hundred forty-one times, and still sending data home.
scenes.label: Voyager 2 · 141 AU

scenes.text: Number one: Voyager 1. About one hundred sixty-nine times, and it takes light nearly a day to reach it.
scenes.label: Voyager 1 · 169 AU

description:
The five farthest human-made objects, ranked by distance from Earth. Distances are measured in astronomical units, where one is the distance from Earth to the Sun.
Voyager 1 is about 169 times that distance, and radio signals take nearly a day to reach it.
Which one would you have wanted to follow?
first_comment: Which one would you put at number one, and what should we rank next?
